facts.fact: ITWeb Africa reports WACS lands in the Republic of Congo and carried Congo Telecom's primary circuits until a 29 October 2026 fault, with traffic failing over to unspecified backup links.

facts.fact: Ecofin reports MTN Congo activated the 2Africa cable at Pointe-Noire on 13 February 2026 as a second international route beside WACS, which Congo has relied on since 2012; 2Africa is given 180 Tbps nominal capacity.
